title: Religions, mentions and healing choices
items: Religions page under Notes: gods, faiths and cults with title, alignment, domains, portfolio, holy symbol, favored weapon, worshippers, temples (linked locations), allied and rival faiths, and what you've learned. NPCs and factions have a Faith field, and #rel links religions in notes.
Mentioned in: every NPC, player, location, faction, religion and map lists the notes, quests and cards that name it. Click one to jump straight there (Game notes scroll to the note).
Renaming an NPC, player, location, faction, religion or map changes the name everywhere it was written, so links keep working.
Potions & oils box on Combat & Effects (Full and Compact).
Healing potions, healing items and cure spells ask how to heal: Roll for me, or roll your own dice and type the total. Choose who's healed (you, a companion or someone else). Cancel spends nothing.
Experience: type the XP you gained and Add XP adds it to your total, with Undo for the last one and a note when you're ready to level up.
Items page: Sort by type, where it is, name, weight or value, with a colour for each kind of item.
Game notes search fixed and improved: matches every word in any order across title, date and text, highlights matches and shows how many notes match.

title: Painted backgrounds for every theme
items: Painted backgrounds for every class and race theme and Old parchment.
Options → Customise: Background now lists None, every painted background (use any of them with any theme) and Upload background for your own picture.
Box opacity slider: choose how much of the background shows through the boxes. Text colours adjust so everything stays easy to read at every setting.
Your own background pictures now show at full strength with see-through boxes, like the painted ones.

title: Updates and Paladin background
items: Updates: Options shows this version and whether a newer one is out, with an Update button and this change log.
Painted background for the Paladin theme. Bright pictures are dimmed a little in dark mode so text stays easy to read.

title: See-through boxes
items: Painted backgrounds show through the boxes, top bar and menu, with text kept easy to read.
Full-width top bar and tidier page tabs.

title: Rogue background
items: Painted background for the Rogue theme: a moonlit city.

title: Save location and Mac app
items: Save location: keep your characters, homebrew and pictures in a folder of your choice (NAS, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive) and share them between computers. Windows and Mac apps, and Chrome or Edge on a computer.
Mac app: one download for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

title: Specialist wizards
items: Specialist wizards: choose a specialty school for the extra spell slot, and prohibited schools.
Magic Missile and Scorching Ray show and roll the right number of missiles or rays for your caster level.

title: Themes
items: Options page with a theme for each character: 20 presets by class and race, your own colours, fonts, borders, title styles, backgrounds and textures.
Adventure layout: an original scene for every class and race, framed boxes and a shield-shaped Armor Class.
Colours are checked automatically so text stays readable in light and dark mode.

title: Combat & Effects
items: Combat & Effects page: every box full width with Full and Compact views.
Attack options (flanking, sneak attack, Power Attack, Rapid Shot, Point Blank Shot and more) and attacks of opportunity that reset each round.
Initiative: a spells and conditions menu for every combatant, who each effect is on, and name suggestions when adding.
Companions as Full/Compact/Hide boxes, shown on Combat & Effects when they're in initiative.
Spells show damage type, dice at your caster level, touch attacks and saves; prepared spells can be limited to your slots.
Magic and custom ammunition, item labels on the Items page, and picture framing for NPCs, players, places and companions.

title: New look
items: Start screen: Continue, New Character, Load Character and Options.
Sidebar menu, and a round box that shows who is up now and next.
Rounded look, Full/Compact/Hide panels on the Character sheet, and a Long rest button.

title: Character Codex
items: The multi-ruleset Character Codex, started from the 3.5 Character Codex: rulesets chosen when a character is made, homebrew by ruleset, and a sheet you can rearrange.
